answer: No firm renewal date is settled for the Helix supplier contract. The Helix Supplier Renewal page records two conflicting dates from October 20 notes: purchasing gives December 3, 2026, and legal gives December 10, 2026. The page states neither note supersedes the other and that the renewal date is unresolved. The Helix-Sandbox (February 5, 2027, confirmed) and Helix-Legacy (unresolved: March 12, 2027 vs. October 19, 2026) renewal pages are separate entities and do not settle the Helix contract date.
